item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cool in the morning and at night over the region. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect southern China early next week. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring rainy weather to the region. With the easterly airstream moderating, it will become warm and humid over the coastal areas gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, a trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of southern China in the latter part of next week.
